title: Formal Resurgence and Differential Transcendence in Lean 4 (stokes-vandermonde)
description: Lean 4 formalization of the Borel–Stokes–Vandermonde criterion and machine-checked proofs of differential transcendence, spectral positivity, and parity dichotomies across analytic number theory, spectral geometry, combinatorics, special functions, and mathematical physics. Version 3.8.0 adds Waves 13B, 14, and 15 (13,619 new lines across 5 strictly additive modules under PakStokes/AllD/, bringing PakStokesAllD to 42,094 lines across 22 modules, with 312 new public declarations / 242 new public theorems), proved 100% unconditionally from Mathlib with zero external hypotheses: (1) Wave 15 — Full End-to-End Analytic Mock-Modular Cusp-to-Stokes Bridge (MockModularRotatedRays.lean 4,867 lines, 86 public decls / 68 theorems; MockModularCuspDescent.lean 4,921 lines, 63 public decls / 49 theorems; 9,788 lines total, Flagship Paper #10 doi:10.5281/zenodo.24590300): Gevrey-1 asymptotics, convergent germ subring convergentSubring, and Watson uniqueness (gevrey1_zero_imp_exp_decay, watson_of_gevrey1_zero); exact (1+w)^{-alpha} Taylor remainder and PhiReal iterated-derivative Gevrey-1 asymptotics (cpow_taylor_integral_remainder, PhiReal_iteratedDeriv_hasGevrey1Asymp); rotated rays gammaMinus/gammaPlus on connected open sectors UPlus/UMinus, angle-invariance (ray_integral_eq_real), and simultaneous lateral annihilation (lateral_simultaneous_annihilation); exact Hankel keyhole reflection jump and termwise differentiation (hankel_single_mode_jump, hankel_series_jump, hankel_series_jump_iteratedDeriv); single-cusp y=1 Eichler integral split and miraculous zero-mode cancellations for k != 1 and k = 1 (eichler_y1_split_cusp, eichler_y1_split_nonOne, eichler_y1_split_one, FHol_differentiableOn_ball); uniform Cauchy q_1-tail bound (cauchy_q1_tail_bound); log/Puiseux scale separation, q_1-induction, top-degree survival, and minimal-degree descent into C{x}[Z] (log_puiseux_scale_separation, q1_induction_kill, top_degree_survival, minimal_degree_descent); and the three end-to-end master assembly theorems (mockModular_scalar_diff_trans_of_cuspSplit, mockModular_joint_shadow_rank_of_cuspSplit, mockModular_joint_diff_indep_of_q1Expansion); (2) Wave 14 — Mod-N Square Partitions and Periodic-Weight Differential Rank Law (SquarePartitionsModN.lean, 2,459 lines, 63 public decls / 47 theorems, Paper #7 Theorem 2.4): Dirichlet primes p = 1 (mod N) (exists_inf_primes_modN_one), Besicovitch two-ray ring TwoRayRing K and T_b d/dT_b strong induction (squareModN_strong_induction, squareModN_wave_diff_indep), general Kolchin log-derivative transfer (diffAlg_kolchin_logDeriv_indep, squareModN_twistedProd_diff_indep), invertible N x N DFT and even/odd square partitions (dftMatrix_det_ne_zero, squareModN_parts_diff_indep, squareModN_parts_diff_indep_of_wave, squareEvenOdd_joint_diff_indep), full periodic-weight differential rank law (squarePeriodicWeights_diff_rank_eq), and countably many multiples-of-d corollary (squareMultiplesOfD_diff_indep), given the wave and log-derivative identities; and (3) Wave 13B — Depth-2 SU(3) Vafa-Witten Commutator and All-n Witness Core (DepthTwoCommutator.lean 728 lines, 54 public decls / 41 theorems; VafaWittenWitnesses.lean 644 lines, 46 public decls / 37 theorems; 1,372 lines total, Paper #11): formal-grading triangular substitution group commutator (triSub_commutator_lower, triSub_commutator_depth2, triCommutatorAlgHom_fixes_lower_poly), shifted and two-sector block Vandermonde nonsingularity (shiftedVandermonde_det_ne_zero, twoSector_blockVandermonde_det_ne_zero), minimal-degree elimination (minimal_degree_elimination_twoSector_vandermonde), exact Bringmann-Nazaroglu (3.2) Z/Q theta multiplicity witnesses for all n >= 1 (vwPairing_flux1_witness, vwPairing_flux0_witness, vwPairing_flux_neg1_eq_flux1, vwCollision_equal_total), and all-order two-sector block elimination (vwWitness_blockMatrix_det_ne_zero, vwWitness_twoSector_minimal_degree_contradiction). All 665 audited declarations in Verify.lean (423 Waves 1-13A + 100% of all 242 public theorems across Waves 13B-15) depend strictly on standard Lean axioms ([propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] or subsets thereof) and pass independent leanchecker --fresh replay. Prime-number-theorem inputs use MediumPNT from PrimeNumberTheoremAnd (PNT+) by Alex Kontorovich, Terence Tao, and contributors. Google Gemini, OpenAI Codex, and Anthropic Claude assisted with exploration, auditing, drafting, and Lean formalization.
